'''Serrod''', also known as '''the Messenger''', was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]] who was part of the [[Infernal Council]], a group of Sith enslaved by the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Soa]] and imprisoned with him in the [[Eternity Vault]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]].<ref name="Eternity Vault" />
